policy: Latest 20 completed full-schedule regular seasons as of the snapshot date, backfilling excluded COVID and lockout seasons. 2021 MLB and NFL are included. Team-record exceptions are documented separately. This policy applies to rarity references, not outcome-fit samples.

nba.note: Excludes 2011–12 (lockout), 2019–20 and 2020–21 (COVID). Includes Boston/Indiana’s 81-game 2012–13 records, normalized by actual games.

nhl.note: Excludes 2004–05 and 2012–13 (lockouts), 2019–20 and 2020–21 (COVID). Includes pre-2005 ties; 82-game history normalized to 84-game pace.

mlb.note: Excludes 2020 (COVID); includes 2021. Completed 161–163-game records normalized by actual games.

nfl.note: Excludes 2020 (COVID); includes 2021. Full 16/17-game schedules normalized; incomplete BUF/CIN 2022 records omitted.

soccer.note: Excludes 2019–20 and 2020–21 (COVID). Each team played 38 matches; earned points before deductions.
